headline: Olympiakos without El Kaabi host unbeaten Sparta Praha
summary: Olympiakos host Sparta Praha in the Europa League on Thursday without striker Ayoub El Kaabi, whose broken leg has cost them 419 minutes this season. They have won their last five matches anyway. Sparta arrive unbeaten, but midfielder Adam Karabec is out with an ankle injury after 970 minutes of football, and their 1.75 expected goals a game does not change the market's view: across 10 bookmakers, margin removed, Olympiakos are 62.2% favourites. The handicap line is one goal in the home side's favour, and over 2.75 goals is priced at 48.7%.
read: Olympiakos host Sparta Praha on a five-match winning run, and the market makes them 62.2% favourites, rated about a goal the better side on the handicap. Sparta arrive unbeaten in five but without midfielder Karabec, and the 2.75 goals line points to a tight night with two or three goals in it.

facts.fact: Olympiakos are 62.2% to win at home; Sparta Praha are 16.4%.
facts.meaning: The home side is a clear favourite — nearly four times Sparta's chance of taking the game.

facts.fact: Olympiakos have won their last five matches, scoring seven and conceding one.
facts.meaning: They come into a home European night on the best run of results in the tie.

facts.fact: The handicap price on Olympiakos -1 moved from 52.6% to 50.4%, the same afternoon Fortounis was ruled out with a muscle injury.
facts.meaning: The market softened slightly on Olympiakos winning by two or more goals.

facts.fact: Sparta midfielder Adam Karabec is out with an ankle injury.
facts.meaning: 970 minutes this season — 12 appearances, 3 goals and 3 assists — makes him the biggest name missing from the visitors' midfield.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is -1.01: Olympiakos are rated about a goal better than Sparta.
facts.meaning: On the main -1 line, an Olympiakos win by exactly one goal is close to a coin flip.

facts.fact: Sparta are unbeaten in five: three wins and two draws.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive in form — their away chance is short precisely because they are hard to beat.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 2.75, with over priced at 48.7%.
facts.meaning: The market expects a game of two or three goals, leaning just under three.

facts.fact: Olympiakos striker Ayoub El Kaabi is out with a broken leg.
facts.meaning: 419 minutes this season from their centre-forward — a hole at the top of the team.

sources.fact: Olympiakos won 1-0 away at Marseille in their previous Europa League match, Hezze scoring, a result that left Marseille bottom of the table while Olympiakos moved up to 15th.

Immanol Algouathil and Yaremchuk gave statements at the pre-match press conference ahead of the home fixture against Sparta Praha in Europa League Matchday 3.
Olympiakos have a poor historical record against Czech opponents, according to Novasports.

Sparta coach Priske said he is thinking mainly about Sparta, not Czech football, though he would take an improvement to the Czech record.
Sparta will try to become the first Czech team to win away at Olympiakos in Thursday's Europa League Matchday 3 game in Piraeus.
